checks.name: generator_hit_target
checks.detail: generator produced 94.8% of its target (368,780 of 388,825)
checks.would_hide: A generator that fell short would leave lag flat, and the pipeline would look like it absorbed a burst it never received.

checks.name: no_counter_reset
checks.would_hide: Collector counters are cumulative. A restart zeroes them, so a run that dropped heavily would report zero drops.

checks.name: sampling_resolution
checks.would_hide: A sampling interval close to the burst length can step over the peak entirely and report that no lag ever occurred.

checks.name: burst_actually_stressed
checks.would_hide: If the burst never built meaningful lag, there is no backpressure behaviour to report and 'recovered instantly' is vacuous.

checks.name: spans_accounted
checks.would_hide: Loss upstream of Redpanda leaves nothing to lag on, so lag reads zero while data is being discarded -- the pipeline looks healthy precisely because it is failing.

checks.name: endpoint_probed_under_load
checks.would_hide: The load generator never makes an HTTP request. Without probing a real endpoint during the burst, 'endpoints are unaffected' would be a claim about something the experiment never exercised.

checks.name: no_rebalance
checks.would_hide: The lag reader joins the same consumer group. If it triggered a rebalance it would be measuring lag it caused itself.
